name: Kleve (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Kleve (three yellow clover leaves and a white shield on red).
history: The city of Kleve was most recently granted arms, a seal and a flag in 1955; the flag of the city shows the colours red and white.

features.role: Kleve arms — three clover leaves and a shield on red
